name: traveller
note: Tests 3D72 against its only consumer. 3D72 writes engine+0x990 = parameter mod 15, and 3D33 picks its vehicle from table D_801C5644[engine+0x990] — 15 indices into the world-map model table 801C5670 (then FFFF), which is why the parameter is taken mod 15; they are model indices, not people (docs/native/native-ship-model.md). Each probe sets a different vehicle, then makes the same 3D33 journey, so any difference in the travel animation is attributable to the vehicle chosen. Values are the original ones: 8 (ミデア, 20 uses), 14 (ラー・カイラム), 3 (ガンドール), and 0, which 3D33 treats as 'the ship ブライト is aboard'. Runs on the world map, before 3D4D.

commands.note: journey from the baseline to entry 2
back to the same start for a fair comparison
vehicle 14 -> model index 7 = ラー・カイラム (5591)
vehicle 3 -> model index 11 = ガンドール (5595)
0 = the ship ブライト is aboard (pair table 801C560C), else index 24
